title: The Vicomte de Bragelonne
author: Alexandre Dumas · Auguste Maquet
description: "The Vicomte de Bragelonne" by Alexandre Dumas and Auguste Maquet is a novel published between 1847 and 1850.
longDescription: The final installment of The d'Artagnan Romances follows the aging musketeers as they navigate the treacherous court of young Louis XIV in 1660s France.

authorInfo.bio: Alexandre Dumas, also known as Alexandre Dumas père, was a French novelist and playwright.
